items.title: Australian business conditions edge higher in July but confidence stays fragile
items.summary: The NAB survey points to an economy holding up better than feared but still operating under the shadow of elevated uncertainty, a combination that gives the RBA little reason to shift from its expected hold today.
items.summaryZh: NAB的调查显示，经济状况好于预期，但仍在不确定性上升的阴影下运行，这一组合使澳联储几乎没有理由放弃今天的预期。
items.summaryEn: The NAB survey points to an economy holding up better than feared but still operating under the shadow of elevated uncertainty, a combination that gives the RBA little reason to shift from its expected hold today.
